tools.name: dixa_get_organization
tools.description: Get the Dixa organization name, subdomain and details. Good first call to confirm the token works. Dixa API: GET /v1/organization.

tools.name: dixa_search_conversations
tools.description: Full-text search over conversations (subjects and message text), with highlights. Returns conversation ids for the other conversation tools. Dixa API: GET /v1/search/conversations.

tools.name: dixa_get_conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation by id, including its channel and requester. Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}.

tools.name: dixa_list_conversation_messages
tools.description: List all messages of a conversation, in order (customer and agent messages). Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.

tools.name: dixa_list_conversation_notes
tools.description: List the internal notes of a conversation (visible to agents only). Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/notes.

tools.name: dixa_list_conversation_tags
tools.description: List the tags on one conversation. Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/tags.

tools.name: dixa_list_conversation_ratings
tools.description: List the latest rating (CSAT/NPS/thumbs) status of a conversation, per survey question. Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/ratings.

tools.name: dixa_get_conversation_activity
tools.description: Get the activity log of one conversation (assignments, status changes, tags). Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/activitylog.

tools.name: dixa_list_flows
tools.description: List the conversation flows, optionally for one channel. Dixa API: GET /v1/conversations/flows.

tools.name: dixa_list_end_users
tools.description: List end users (customers), optionally filtered by email, phone or external id. Dixa API: GET /v1/endusers.

tools.name: dixa_get_end_user
tools.description: Get one end user (customer) by id. Dixa API: GET /v1/endusers/{userId}.

tools.name: dixa_list_end_user_conversations
tools.description: List the conversations of one end user (customer). Dixa API: GET /v1/endusers/{userId}/conversations.

tools.name: dixa_list_agents
tools.description: List agents and admins of the organization, optionally filtered by email or phone. Dixa API: GET /v1/agents.

tools.name: dixa_get_agent
tools.description: Get one agent or admin by id. Dixa API: GET /v1/agents/{agentId}.

tools.name: dixa_list_agents_presence
tools.description: List the presence status of all agents in the organization. Dixa API: GET /v1/agents/presence.

tools.name: dixa_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams of the organization. Dixa API: GET /v1/teams.

tools.name: dixa_get_team
tools.description: Get one team by id. Dixa API: GET /v1/teams/{teamId}.

tools.name: dixa_list_team_members
tools.description: List the agents who are members of one team. Dixa API: GET /v1/teams/{teamId}/agents.

tools.name: dixa_list_queues
tools.description: List the queues that route conversations to agents. Dixa API: GET /v1/queues.

tools.name: dixa_get_queue
tools.description: Get one queue by id. Dixa API: GET /v1/queues/{queueId}.

tools.name: dixa_list_tags
tools.description: List the conversation tags of the organization. Dixa API: GET /v1/tags.

tools.name: dixa_list_custom_attributes
tools.description: List the custom attribute definitions (for conversations and end users). Dixa API: GET /v1/custom-attributes.

tools.name: dixa_list_business_hours_schedules
tools.description: List the business hours schedules. Dixa API: GET /v1/business-hours/schedules.

tools.name: dixa_get_business_hours_status
tools.description: Check whether a business hours schedule is open now, or at a given time. Dixa API: GET /v1/business-hours/schedules/{scheduleId}/status.

tools.name: dixa_list_knowledge_collections
tools.description: List the knowledge base collections (help centers). Dixa API: GET /v1/knowledge/collections.

tools.name: dixa_get_knowledge_article
tools.description: Get one knowledge base article by id, with its translations. Dixa API: GET /v1/knowledge/articles/{articleId}.

tools.name: dixa_add_internal_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a conversation. Internal notes are not sent to the customer. Dixa API: POST /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/notes.

tools.name: dixa_close_conversation
tools.description: Close a conversation by id. Dixa API: PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/close.

tools.name: dixa_reopen_conversation
tools.description: Reopen a closed conversation. Dixa API: PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/reopen.

tools.name: dixa_tag_conversation
tools.description: Add an active tag to a conversation. Dixa API: PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/tags/{tagId}.

tools.name: dixa_untag_conversation
tools.description: Remove a tag from a conversation. Dixa API: DELETE /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/tags/{tagId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dixa_search_conversations, dixa_list_conversation_messages, dixa_list_end_users, dixa_list_agents · Private data: dixa_get_organization · Public sink: dixa_list_end_users, dixa_list_agents, dixa_add_internal_note · Destructive: dixa_untag_conversation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dixa_search_conversations, dixa_list_conversation_messages, dixa_list_end_users, dixa_list_agents · Private data: dixa_get_organization · Public sink: dixa_list_end_users, dixa_list_agents, dixa_add_internal_note · Destructive: dixa_untag_conversation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
